vsam.why: base/cntl/adef121.jcl DEFINE1: DATA(... KEYS(10 0) RECORDSIZE(225 225)); the engine's facts do not read KEYS / RECORDSIZE inside the DATA component, so the case states them

scenarios.name: add-with-counter
scenarios.why: GET COUNTER GENA/GENACUSTNUM: NORMAL, 1000011 (the counter is then 1000012); INSERT CUSTOMER with that number; LINK LGACVS01 writes the VSAM copy; LINK LGACDB02 adds the CUSTOMER_SECURE row; CA-CUSTOMER-NUM 1000011, '00'

scenarios.name: add-without-counter
scenarios.why: no named counter (NOTFND): INSERT with DEFAULT, the identity gives 1000001 (START WITH, restarted each run), SET :H = IDENTITY_VAL_LOCAL() reads it back on the INSERT's own connection

scenarios.name: add-blank-optional-fields
scenarios.why: blank house name / number / phones / email stored as blanks (CHAR), not NULL

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: IF EIBCALEN IS EQUAL TO ZERO -- EM-VARIABLE ' NO COMMAREA RECEIVED', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG (it writes the message to TD CSMT and TS GENAERRS: #4607), IF EIBCALEN > 0 is false, then ABEND LGCA

notes: GenApp's add-customer service (LGACDB01, LINKed with the LGCMAREA COMMAREA, described by its caller LGACUS01's record): the customer number is the named counter GENACUSTNUM in pool GENA (GET COUNTER), else Db2's identity (INSERT ... DEFAULT, then SET :H = IDENTITY_VAL_LOCAL()); the CUSTOMER row is INSERTed, LGACVS01 is LINKed to write the VSAM copy and LGACDB02 to add the CUSTOMER_SECURE row (default password). The case runs LGACVS01 and LGACDB02 in the same task; each scenario says which named counters the region has. #4607 / X6 (owner decision): LGSTSQ runs in the same task ("programs"; "region" for its ASSIGN SYSID). An EIBCALEN-0 task (no-commarea) LINKs it with the short ERROR-MSG and ABENDs LGCA, compared whole (the WRITEQ TD and WRITEQ TS it writes too). An error path with the 32500-byte COMMAREA LINKs it a second time with the 99-byte CA-ERROR-MSG; LGSTSQ then writes 104 bytes from its 95-byte WRITE-MSG (X6), so that task is judged up to the refused WRITEQ: what it did before is compared, its end state is not. Not settled on z/OS (#4050). Still not reached: IF EIBCALEN < 91 true (a COMMAREA shorter than 91 bytes; the harness passes the case's whole COMMAREA).
